text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding for BlueRock (SI) starts next week. We need to lock the lead handoff flow and account mapping so we don't double-touch accounts. Quick sync?
ajay: Do we have a current SFDC rule for SI ownership? Who becomes the owner when SI claims a lead?
kim: Prefer approach: SI gets a temporary "si_claim" flag + assignment to a Partner Intake queue. AE remains primary owner in the canonical account record. RevOps can automate TTL on the claim.
sophie: I can add the SFDC field. Proposal: Partner_Claim__c with values [claimed, pending, unclaimed] and a claim_owner queue. Example mapping:
```
Partner_Claim__c = 'claimed'
Owner = 'partner_queue'
TTL = 5d
```
taylor: Operational ROE suggestion: SI has 5 business days to accept scope and contact the AE. Within 5d if no acceptance -> auto-reassign back to AE with note "SI did not respond". SI gets 2 intro touches from AE before AE continues outbound.
raj: For pipeline credit + co-sell: if SI sources the lead -> referral credit. If both engage within 30 days -> co-sourced split. Joint announcement requires co-sell approval + PR window (2 weeks) and product comms sign-off.
maria: Can RevOps spin up a simple intake form (Google/Typeform) so SI claims include: account SFDC id, contact, brief scope, estimated ARR, geo, and desired handoff TTL. Also want a slack webhook to ping #partnerships when a claim is made.
partners-bot: Reminder: BlueRock onboarding call scheduled Thu 2026-03-25 10:00 PDT.
ajay: I'll draft the one-pager with the ROE and initial intake form. RevOps (sophie/kim) — can you push SFDC changes by EOD Friday?
kim: Yep. I'll add automation: when Partner_Claim__c=claimed -> assign to partner_queue and start TTL=5d countdown; after TTL -> escalate to partner_ops@redwood.com and tag AE.
sophie: Created CHG-1234 to track the SFDC changes and automation. Will update when deployed.
taylor: Can we run a 10-account pilot (seeded) to validate flows + partner outreach cadence? @maria
maria: Yes — send list by EOD Wed and we'll kick the pilot after the onboarding call.
ajay: Thanks all — I'll post the draft one-pager and form link here when ready. :thumbsup:
